findings.en: This link changed while you were reviewing it. Reopen the prompt to confirm the latest.
findings.current: Este vínculo cambió mientras lo revisabas. Vuelve a abrir el aviso para confirmar la última versión.
findings.problem: Wrong referent. The string is shown ON the panel's notice line (hub_links_panel.py:605 assigns it to self._notice), so 'el aviso' points at the message the user is reading; the thing to reopen is the consent prompt this product elsewhere calls 'prompt' (25 shipped es uses). Spanish reserves 'aviso' for notifications/warnings (tui.notifications, tui.schedule, tui.import).
findings.suggestion: Este vínculo cambió mientras lo revisabas. Vuelve a abrir el prompt para confirmar la última versión. (or '… la confirmación …' to avoid the anglicism)
findings.evidence: hub_links_panel.py:601-607; grep of shipped es catalogues for 'prompt' (25 hits) and 'aviso' (20 hits, all notice/warning senses)

findings.en: This link's history isn't known yet, so it can't publish unattended. Pull or resolve it first.
findings.current: Todavía no se conoce el historial de este vínculo, así que no puede publicar sin supervisión. Haz pull primero o resuélvelo.
findings.problem: The clitic 'lo' has two competing masculine antecedents inside one sentence (el historial, el vínculo) and the recovery differs: it is the link that must be resolved before auto-push can be enabled.
findings.suggestion: … así que no puede publicar sin supervisión. Primero haz pull o resuelve el vínculo.
findings.evidence: en source phrasing 'Resolve it first'; the U4 reason map in hub_links_panel.py:73-77

findings.en: Publishing to this public location needs your explicit consent first.
findings.current: Publicar en esta ubicación pública requiere antes tu consentimiento explícito.
findings.problem: 'requiere antes tu consentimiento' places the adverb between verb and object; natural Spanish says 'requiere primero …'.
findings.suggestion: Publicar en esta ubicación pública requiere primero tu consentimiento explícito.
findings.evidence: idiom judgement; meaning is correct, so this is preference only

findings.problem: Two bare words read as Spanglish, where the shipped CLI copy uses 'hacer push' / 'hacer pull' (cli.teams_help). 'pull' itself is on the kept-English list, so the fix is the verb around it, not the term.
findings.suggestion: Hacer pull ahora (16 cells; 'Comprobar ahora' is 15, so the panel has room)
findings.evidence: cli.teams_help es 'Hacer push (subir) de un agente …'; glossary wave-2 kept-English set
